item.hollow.shadow_fragment.tooltip: A sliver of solidified dark. It is still cold.
item.hollow.warding_totem.tooltip: Keep it on you. The Watcher cannot bear its gaze. It cracks each time it wards you.
item.hollow.warding_totem.flare: Your Warding Totem flares, holding the gaze at bay...
item.hollow.warding_totem.broken: Your Warding Totem crumbles to dust!
item.hollow.third_eye.tooltip: Hold to perceive your Dread and reveal Watchers through the dark.
block.hollow.hallowed_lantern.tooltip: Its blessed light calms Dread and keeps the dark at bay.
